authorize.description: F-012: the authorization popup (label auth-<hash>) may invoke ONLY the two commands its flow needs — reading the verified-site badge and returning the user's decision. It explicitly canNOT reach settings mutators (remove_approved_origin, enable_safari_support) or the updater, which the ungated pre-F-012 surface allowed.

onboarding.description: F-012: the first-run onboarding wizard (label onboarding) may invoke ONLY its own commands. No core:default / autostart / updater plugin grants — the frontend calls Rust wrappers that drive plugins natively (enable_https / set_autostart_inner / config writes), and the window is closed from Rust.

renewal.description: F-012: the certificate-renewal consent window (label renewal, macOS/Windows only) may invoke ONLY its own commands. No plugin/core grants — renewal rotates the cert via a Rust wrapper and the window is closed from Rust.

settings.description: F-012: the Settings window may invoke ONLY the settings commands. No core:default / autostart / process / updater plugin grants — the frontend calls Rust wrappers that drive plugins natively, and the window is closed from Rust, so it needs no plugin/core JS API.

update-prompt.description: F-012: the update prompt (label update-prompt) may invoke ONLY respond_update_prompt. Preserves F-004: it has NO updater:default / process grants — updates flow through the Rust check/perform path that verifies the signed manifest + monotonic floor.
